32-shape-morphing-gallery.visual_critic_note: Clean grid layout and deliberate Tol palette show design intent, but 5 of 9 panels render completely empty in the screenshot — a hard visual failure that makes half the gallery look broken regardless of whether it's a timing artifact.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.encoding_integrity_note: Stacked bar encoding bug: segment heights use `h - y(d.val)` (individual value from baseline) instead of `y(d.cumY) - y(d.cumY + d.val)` (correct segment height), causing visual overlap and misrepresentation; all scale domains are hardcoded magic numbers rather than data-driven.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.stress_test_note: No user-driven event handlers (no brush, zoom, or drag) means update storms, stale closures, and mouse-touch fights are structurally impossible; the loopMorph callback chain is sequential and safe, with the only minor gap being the absence of .interrupt() guards should init ever be called twice.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.cognitive_load_note: 9-panel grid is a single conceptual unit (morph gallery), cells are well-sized and clearly labeled, but simultaneous independent animations in all 9 cells compete for attention — perceptual evaluation of animation quality is limited from a static screenshot.
